properties.description: • In 1799, approximately 89 enslaved people lived and worked at the Mansion House Farm. • As many as 15 to 20 slaves lived in each of four sleeping rooms that were similar to this one.
properties.name: Slave Quarters - Women's Bunk Room

properties.description: • The slave quarters connected to the greenhouse underwent a major interior restoration and reinterpretation in 2010. • As many as 20 enslaved male workers of varying ages may have slept in this room.
properties.name: Slave Quarters - Men's Bunk Room

properties.description: Meet the people who shaped Mount Vernon, including Washington and Custis family members, enslaved and hired laborers, and Vice Regents of the Mount Vernon Ladies' Association, which has owned and preserved Mount Vernon since the 19th century.
properties.name: Mount Vernon: The Story of an American Icon

properties.description: At the Eagles Theater, learn about the important legacy of George and Martha Washington, the estate, and Mount Vernon’s enslaved community. Connect to this history and the role of the Mount Vernon Ladies’ Association in saving and preserving Mount Vernon.
properties.name: Orientation Film

properties.description: During the Mansion Revitalization Project, rooms will be taken off display for extended periods. Although you can't see some of the rooms in person, you can view them and the objects inside with an interpreter-led virtual tour shown at the Smith Theater.
properties.name: Virtual Mansion Tour

properties.description: Opening this June, Lives Bound Together: Slavery at Mount Vernon explores the personal stories of the people enslaved at Mount Vernon while providing insight into George Washington’s evolving opposition to slavery.
properties.name: Lives Bound Together: Slavery at Mount Vernon

properties.description: Experience the American Revolution as you walk through an 18th-century Continental Army encampment featuring soldiers' tents and an officer’s tent. Get hands-on discovering items throughout the encampment.
properties.name: Patriots Path: A Revolutionary War Encampment
